parameters.content:
## PrivaTools: merge
1. Select Header Auth (X-API-Key) in all HTTP nodes.
2. Execute with the synthetic sample, or replace Sample PDFs with binary input.
3. Save Remember job output to resume. Reuse idempotencyKey only for the same operation/options/ordered file bytes.
4. Save binary.result to your destination. Results expire one hour after completion.
5. Run n8n-delete-job.json only after saving, or to cancel deliberately.

Uploads/results may also be saved by YOUR n8n execution history. Configure its retention. No credentials are embedded. Network errors stop safely; retry with the same key/job ID.
